catalogue.title: Itineraries
catalogue.intro: Integration sheets written and checked by other developers, sorted by service, country and stack.
catalogue.emptyText: Remove a filter, or publish the sheet the community is missing.

filters.heading: Filters
filters.searchHelp: A service, a word from the content, an error message.

state.clear: {{count}} developers made it work in the last 90 days.
state.one: Only one developer checked it in the last 90 days: a clear road needs two.
state.none: Nobody checked it in the last 90 days.

detail.logLabel_one: {{count}} check in the last 90 days, one cell per week
detail.logLabel_other: {{count}} checks in the last 90 days, one cell per week
detail.test: Try it on the test track
detail.testSoon: The {{service}} test track comes with the next module.
detail.testNone: No test track for {{service}}: its technical documentation is not public.
detail.verifyNote: Confirms the sheet works today, with your country and your environment.
detail.verifyOwn: You wrote this sheet: another developer has to check it.
detail.verifyTooSoon: You already checked it. You can check it again from {{date}}.
detail.verified: Thank you, your check is recorded.
detail.fallback: This itinerary does not exist in your language yet. You are reading the {{language}} version.
detail.removeText: It will disappear from the catalogue and from searches. Its checks will no longer count.
detail.notFoundText: Its author may have deleted it.

potholes.heading: Potholes
potholes.intro: Traps reported by other developers. Two unresolved potholes are enough to report the sheet broken.
potholes.reported: Thank you, the pothole is reported.

checks.heading: Checks
checks.intro: Each line is a developer who made this sheet work on their side, on that date.

dialog.verifyText: Your check is dated today and visible to everyone. You can check this sheet again in 30 days.
dialog.country: Country where you made it work
dialog.reportText: Describe what does not work, as you would have liked to read it before integrating.

editor.intro: Start from the template: prerequisites, installation, payment, webhook, known traps. Every save creates a version.
editor.title: Title
editor.titleHelp: 8 to 140 characters. Name the service, the action and the stack.
editor.languageHelp: Changing the language replaces untouched content with the template of that language.
editor.contentHelp: Headings, lists and code blocks between three backticks. HTML is not interpreted.
editor.languageLocked: A version keeps its language: to write another language, translate the sheet from its page.
